name: Merit Interactive Co.,Ltd.
summary: Merit Interactive Co., Ltd. operates as a specialized data intelligence firm based in China. The company delivers advanced data-driven solutions, encompassing sophisticated push notification services. Leveraging extensive big data analytics, they develop in-depth user profiles and implement real-time scene recognition functionalities. These capabilities empower mobile application developers to precisely target users, enabling the delivery of filtered and personalized push messages, as well as intelligent recommendations for app updates and downloads. Furthermore, Merit Interactive provides performance advertising services, underpinned by its robust big data solutions tailored for a wide array of industries. Established in 2010, the company maintains its headquarters in Hangzhou, China. It underwent a name change in October 2020, transitioning from its previous designation, Zhejiang Merit Interactive Network Technology Co., Ltd., to its current identity.
